settings.heading: App settings
settings.introduction: Shared across all workspaces. Your workspace stays where it is. Opening this dialog performs no native operation.
settings.saveFailed: Previous stored settings are unchanged. Correct the draft and save again.
settings.unsaved: Unsaved changes · Cancel or Escape discards them
settings.languageHelp: Language changes only after Save succeeds. Selecting a language does not preview it. Cancel keeps the saved language.
settings.notificationsHelp: Short-lived cards at the bottom right. Blocking failures and cleanup outcomes remain on the Run page regardless of cards.
settings.visibleHelp: Older cards leave the stack immediately; every event stays in the relevant log.
settings.timeoutHelp: The timer pauses while you hover or focus a card. Cards already shown keep the duration they were created with.
settings.successHelp: Warnings and errors are never suppressed by this switch.
settings.logsHelp: One bounded buffer shared by every workspace and application log page. File logs and delivery queues are unaffected.
settings.saveError: Settings were not saved · draft kept

invalid.one: Correct {count} invalid field before saving · Cancel or Escape discards all edits
invalid.other: Correct {count} invalid fields before saving · Cancel or Escape discards all edits
invalid.oneCategories: Correct {count} invalid field in {categories} before saving · Cancel or Escape discards all edits
invalid.otherCategories: Correct {count} invalid fields in {categories} before saving · Cancel or Escape discards all edits

settings.wait: Save waits until “{reason}” settles · Cancel or Escape discards unsaved edits
settings.logLimitHelp: 1–10000 · default 1000 · saved limit {limit}. Lowering it trims the shared history immediately after Save.

environment.noDescriptor: None selected · initialization could not be checked
environment.setDescriptor: None · set the recorded corpus descriptor on the workspace Run page
environment.authority: A check never admits a run. Start captures and revalidates every file again, including same-path replacements; no path is watched.
environment.saveFirst: Save an OCR environment to enable Check.
environment.dirty: Check reads saved settings only. Save changes first.
environment.active: Another operation owns the runner until its terminal outcome is recorded.
environment.introduction: Machine-local, saved in App settings, never in portable profiles. Save validates structure only; Check initializes the engine.
environment.modelPlaceholder: Absolute path to the accepted model files
environment.runtimePlaceholder: Absolute path to the pinned ONNX runtime library
environment.libraries: Reviewed native library paths · one per line
environment.librariesPlaceholder: Explicit non-system libraries the engine child may load
environment.librariesHelp: Enter 1–64 absolute paths; blank lines are ignored. Rust canonicalizes them and derives file and SDK identities during Check and again on every Start. Listing a path is not an audit of every loaded image.
environment.blank: Saving a blank draft stores no OCR environment.
environment.saveHelp: Save changes below writes this environment with the other App settings.
environment.checkHelp: Validates files, then initializes the engine against the selected corpus without evaluating package code. Stop applies.
environment.noCorpus: Without a descriptor, Check validates files and reports the missing corpus; it cannot claim initialization.
environment.noChecks: No check has completed in this session.

truncated.one: Display truncated: {count} more character is not rendered.
truncated.other: Display truncated: {count} more characters are not rendered.

environment.staleHelp: This result belongs to its original selection only: {reasons}. It does not make the current environment appear checked.
environment.wait: {reason} · Check waits until this command settles.

profileLabels.g-004-rapidocr-ppocrv4-det-v6-rec-small-: G-004 · RapidOCR PP-OCRv4 det v6 / rec small v1

environment.mismatch: The saved environment carries a tuple this desktop build does not offer ({model} / {language} / {provider} / {runtime}). Saving replaces it with the supported tuple shown above.

run.introduction: Edits affect the next operation, never the active snapshot. Every Start revalidates files; no check or inspection is reused.
run.diagnosticHelp: Full diagnostics are available through explicit private disclosure in the Execution panel.
run.noOperations: No operation for this workspace yet
run.replaySummary: Recorded corpus, real recognition, controlled sink
run.controlledSummary: Fixture observations, no live capture or input
run.confirmReinspect: Discard the unsaved draft and reinspect this package?
run.reinspectBlocked: Inspection is refused while this workspace owns an operation
run.reinspectHelp: Reinspection validates inventory, schema, and static dependencies without executing package code; it increments the selection revision and resets the draft.
run.profilesError: Some saved profiles could not be loaded
run.profilesHelp: Compatible profiles and new drafts remain available. Stored files were not modified. Restore compatible data, then reinspect.
run.staleSchema: Stale schema identity. This profile cannot be rebound or run.
run.presetHelp: Choosing a preset creates a new draft. Save it with a name to keep it.
run.optionsHelp: Missing top-level fields use schema defaults. Explicit objects are never recursively filled. Backend validation reports exact field paths.
run.replay: Replay · recorded corpus, real recognition, controlled sink
run.native: Native · refused, no live capture or input
run.descriptorPlaceholder: Absolute path to a replay descriptor JSON
run.authority: Submitted does not prove effect; Stop does not prove cleanup. Stop covers checks and runs alike.
run.capturedOptions: Captured options · unchanged by draft edits
run.capturedEnvironment: Captured saved environment · unchanged by later edits
run.heading: {label} / Run control
run.descriptorHelp: A location hint for this workspace session only, bounded to {limit} bytes. Replay Start and OCR Check read the descriptor and its declared assets through this package's inventory each time; unknown or native fields are refused.

startUses.draft: Start uses the explicit draft shown here.
startUses.replayProfile: Start uses saved profile “{profile}”, the saved OCR environment ({environment}), and descriptor {descriptor}.
startUses.replayDraft: Start uses the explicit draft shown here, the saved OCR environment ({environment}), and descriptor {descriptor}.

run.olderRevision: This outcome belongs to selection revision {old}; the workspace is now at revision {current}. It is not evidence for the current draft.
run.stopTarget: Stop targets operation {operation} regardless of the visible workspace.

result.checkHelp: No package module, readiness, or workflow code was evaluated. Engine facts are the child's own report.
result.privateHelp: Script decisions and observation records stay hidden until disclosed below. Full records are not automatically copied to ordinary logs; scripts can explicitly emit bounded messages.

truncated.one: Display truncated: {count} more character is retained by the backend record but not rendered.
truncated.other: Display truncated: {count} more characters are retained by the backend record but not rendered.

disclosureHelp.ordinary: Build metadata, diagnostics. Rendered here only, bounded to {kib} KiB.
disclosureHelp.private: Build metadata, diagnostics, and recognition detail. Rendered here only, bounded to {kib} KiB.

schema.omitted: Omitted · no nested defaults are applied.

logs.missingHelp: It was evicted from the bounded display buffer or never delivered to the GUI queue. Retained operation outcomes stay on the Run page; file logs are unaffected.
logs.search: Search code, message, source, or run
logs.searchPlaceholder: Search code, message, source, or run ID
logs.empty: No retained events for this scope. Events may still have been evicted from the display buffer or written only to file logs.
logs.order: Newest first · search matches code, message, source, and run only

filtered.one: No retained events match the current filters. {count} event in this scope is hidden by filtering.
filtered.other: No retained events match the current filters. {count} events in this scope are hidden by filtering.

lossHelp.loss: Loss counters are cumulative and independent of this page. Display eviction does not delete file records or change retained results. A filtered or empty page is not a claim that no events occurred.
lossHelp.none: No display eviction, transport loss, or file-output failure has been recorded. Display eviction does not delete file records or change retained results. A filtered or empty page is not a claim that no events occurred.
